The University of Texas at Austin Medical Reserve Corps (UTMRC)
Meet our leadership team who collaborate, adequately train our body of volunteers, and create sustainability within the organization.
When hurricanes, floods, wildfires, or other public health emergencies strike, trained volunteers are often among the first to step in and help.
The University of Texas Medical Reserve Corps (UTMRC) is committed to preparing healthcare professionals, students, and community volunteers to respond when our communities need them most.

Our Just in Time training (JIT) include resources on topics such as Mental Health Team, Contact Tracing, Testing/Swabbing, and Alternate Care Site that is made available to support preparedness training activities and provide JIT training for our members and volunteers.
